trigger: Caption-stability browser capture 38 resized to 883x786, capture 39 restored 672x711 but retained the previous translation; capture 40 recovered only after a stable reload.
invariants: Camera remains transient UI/session state, outside CanvasDocument, undo history, architecture and publication export.
Idle viewport size changes preserve world centre and zoom by translating half the CSS size delta.
Camera persistence uses its established viewport anchor, never an uncoordinated live DOM size.
Active pan, move, box and port gestures retain their original coordinate mapping; resize coordination resumes after their terminal sample or cancellation.
Explicit fit, zoom, focus and document initialization establish a fresh viewport anchor.
Observer callbacks verify the current viewport element and document owner before applying; initialization retains load, intent, identity and revision tickets.
implementation: Independent cameraViewport helper; useLayoutEffect initializes the real element subscription and ResizeObserver uses flushSync so resize camera updates are committed before the observer delivery reaches paint. Window resize is a limited fallback when ResizeObserver is unavailable.
risksAndValidation: First observer delivery must not reinterpret an unowned or newly loading camera; frozen and live ownership checks must reject it.
A resize before pointerup with pending animation-frame preview must preserve the actual terminal pan/move result; focused actual-App callback tests will exercise this ordering.
A document switch, revision change or explicit camera intent must not allow stale initialization or observer work to overwrite the active view.
Callback harnesses do not mount React or prove browser paint ordering. Root will perform actual CUA resize, remount and gesture QA.
No model execution, publication aesthetics, human usability or presented performance gate is claimed.
